value.rationale: The theorem directly resolves a discrepancy at the benchmark's designated critical resolution: standard aligned bins are exactly blind at \(N=2k\), whereas a half-bin shift recovers the entire population discrepancy. It also identifies the published sinc curve as an exact randomized-origin average. This changes the interpretation of a current calibration-testing example and yields a concrete phase-robust design lesson, rather than merely renaming or numerically recomputing a known quantity.
